### CURTISS-WRIGHT AWARDED CONTRACTS VALUED IN EXCESS OF $225 MILLION TO SUPPORT CRITICAL U.S. NAVY AIRCRAFT CARRIER AND SUBMARINE PLATFORMS


November 04, 2026


DAVIDSON, N.C.


–


**** Curtiss-Wright Corporation (NYSE: CW) today announced it was awarded contracts valued in excess of $225 million by Bechtel Plant Machinery, Inc. (BPMI) to provide advanced propulsion valves, pumps and instrumentation and control systems for the U.S. Navy’s Virginia-class nuclear powered attack submarine, Columbia-class submarine and Ford-class aircraft carrier programs. Under the agreement, Curtiss-Wright will supply critical technology to support ongoing ship construction and fleet maintenance activities.


“Curtiss-Wright is proud to provide mission-critical products that enhance the performance, reliability, and readiness of the U.S. Navy’s nuclear fleet,” said Lynn M. Bamford, Chair and CEO of Curtiss-Wright Corporation. “The Company maintains a longstanding partnership with the U.S. Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program, consistently delivering highly engineered solutions that contribute to our nation’s strong defense capabilities. Furthermore, Curtiss-Wright remains well positioned to benefit from the administration’s continued strong funding for naval shipbuilding supporting the acceleration of production on its most critical platforms.”


Curtiss-Wright is performing this work at its facilities in New York and Pennsylvania within the Company’s Defense Electronics and Naval & Power Segments. Engineering, manufacturing, and testing are currently underway, and will continue through 2030.


For over 60 years, Curtiss-Wright has been a trusted supplier to the U.S. Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program supporting every nuclear-powered submarine and aircraft carrier commissioned by the U.S. Navy. Curtiss-Wright’s portfolio includes advanced propulsion equipment, instrumentation and control systems, pumps, valves, motors, and other mission-critical technologies that improve operational performance, increase reliability, enhance safety, and help reduce lifecycle costs for the Navy’s fleet.


For more information on Curtiss-Wright’s Defense Electronics Segment and Naval & Power Segment products for the U.S. Navy, please visit[www.cwdefense.com](https://defense-solutions.curtisswright.com/) or[www.curtisswright.com/organization/naval-power](https://curtisswright.com/organization/naval-power) , respectively.


**About Curtiss-Wright Corporation**


Curtiss-Wright Corporation (NYSE: CW) is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions and services mainly to Aerospace & Defense markets, as well as critical technologies in demanding Commercial Nuclear Power, Process and Industrial markets. We leverage a workforce of approximately 9,300 highly skilled employees who develop, design and build what we believe are the best engineered solutions to the markets we serve. Building on the heritage of Glenn Curtiss and the Wright brothers, Curtiss-Wright has a long tradition of providing innovative solutions through trusted customer relationships. For more information, visit[www.curtisswright.com](https://curtisswright.com/) .
